title: Detailed red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='appleBody' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#e53935'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#c62828'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8e1b1b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='appleShine' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- apple body -->
  <path d='M50 26
    C 36 26, 22 36, 22 55
    C 22 72, 34 84, 50 84
    C 66 84, 78 72, 78 55
    C 78 36, 64 26, 50 26 Z'
    fill='url(#appleBody)' />

  <!-- left blush / lighter red patch -->
  <path d='M36 34
    C 27 40, 24 50, 25 60
    C 26 70, 32 78, 40 81
    C 33 74, 29 64, 30 54
    C 31 44, 34 38, 36 34 Z'
    fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.55' />

  <!-- right darker shadow -->
  <path d='M64 34
    C 73 41, 76 52, 75 62
    C 74 72, 68 79, 60 82
    C 67 74, 70 64, 69 54
    C 68 44, 65 38, 64 34 Z'

  <!-- main highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='42' rx='13' ry='9' fill='url(#appleShine)' transform='rotate(-25 41 42)' />
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.75' />

  <!-- top dimple -->
  <path d='M42 27
    C 45 30, 47 31, 50 31
    C 53 31, 55 30, 58 27
    C 56 33, 53 36, 50 36
    C 47 36, 44 33, 42 27 Z'
    fill='#a31818' opacity='0.6' />

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 30
    C 49 24, 50 19, 53 15
    C 53 20, 52 25, 53 30'
    fill='none' stroke='#7a4a1e' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' />

  <!-- stem lighter edge -->
  <path d='M50.5 29

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 20
    C 58 14, 68 14, 72 17
    C 67 17, 60 19, 54 24
    C 53 22, 52 21, 52 20 Z'
    fill='#43a047' />
  <path d='M53 21
    C 58 17, 64 16, 69 17
    C 64 18, 58 20, 54 23 Z'
    fill='#81c784' opacity='0.8' />
  <path d='M53.5 21
    C 58 18, 63 17, 67 17.5'
    fill='none' stroke='#2e7d32' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.8' />
</svg>
